name: robots/anhtuduong__ur5legovision
title: UR5LegoVision UR5 ROS 1 arm
intro: UR5LegoVision UR5 ROS 1 arm, adapted from anhtuduong/ur5legovision. It reads `read_joint_state` and `read_ee_pose`; runs `move_joints`, `move_gripper`, `pause` and `resume`. `move_joints`: command six joint positions through the upstream /ur5/move_joints service; the boolean acknowledgement does not establish measured arrival. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
